review_process: Parent source/diff review plus separately prompted read-only gpt-5.6-sol/ultra source_tkt, representation_tkt and adversarial_tkt. Initial source and representation objections adjudicated; final immutable-head review recorded in Git-local receipt. Correlated computation, not independent human or experimental validation.
source_inspection: Retained SI printed pp5-7, equations3/6-8 and scheme; Extended Data Figure1c-d/2e-f legends, Data Availability; Table2a E160Q row/footnotec; retained T6F dictionary and coordinates. PDF pp6/8 visually checked. Publisher bodies remain host-local.

adjudications.objection: A fitted transition and present bond could be promoted to an elementary bond-making rate.
adjudications.decision: Accept source-described formation/reversal and a partial bond annotation only. No authenticated atomic before state, complete map, carbonyl/proton/electron changes or isolated microscopic chemical rate.
adjudications.evidence: SI equations3/6-8 and ED Figure1c-d/2e-f; original study limits.

adjudications.objection: Reverse binding may be confused with donor scissile-bond cleavage.
adjudications.decision: Bind k_reverse to conjugate-to-Michaelis reversal; donor cleavage to DHEThDP+E4P has explicit unassigned parameter slots. Generic endpoint-direction checks reject that reassignment.
adjudications.evidence: SI equation3 K3 versus equation8 reversible binding scheme.

adjudications.objection: Opaque context retrieval would repeat existing study annotations without enforcing reusable relations.
adjudications.decision: Introduce separate generic source-model links, with exact source/provider references, directional parameter slots and existing observation identity. Keep exact-sequence state_links unchanged. No enzyme-specific runtime logic. Real second-case reuse remains to be demonstrated.
adjudications.evidence: Current consumer state_links needs exact sequence and one source row; TKT sequence remains null and NMR/stopped-flow use separate providers.

adjudications.objection: Source atom labels and coordinate evidence could imply an observed before-state map or full reacted chemistry.
adjudications.decision: Mark C2x/CF2 and C3x/CF3 as project nomenclature interpretations. Check both deposit dictionary/metric atom pairs and retain original conditions/occupancies; no graph replay or physical state equivalence.
adjudications.evidence: ED Figure1c caption, T6F dictionary and unchanged arrangement projection.

adjudications.objection: Qualitative accumulation could become zero cleavage or be combined with fitted rates as microscopic K2.
adjudications.decision: Keep NMR as state evidence at20C/30s; stopped-flow is at4C. No cleavage fraction, zero rate, cross-assay K2 or productive F6P turnover.
adjudications.evidence: SI pp5-7; ED Figure1d; original observation conditions.

adjudications.objection: Redistribution wording could incorrectly cover the already tracked coordinate body.
adjudications.decision: The four reused publisher bodies remain undistributed; existing RCSB6HA3 coordinate remains redistributed and unchanged.
adjudications.evidence: Existing source inventory and current acquisition scope.

adjudications.objection: A correctly bound compiled endpoint could still carry a different original observation, assay or bond role.
adjudications.decision: Require original observation ID/object and exact original state-relation set/arrangement ID; compiled assay-provider equality plus paired reverse-assay equality; source/deposit atom aliases and transition bond roles must match. Preserve these reviewer-discovered failures in mutation tests.
adjudications.evidence: Read-only representation review of current candidate; X5P source-observation, relation, assay and bond-role substitutions.
